title: QQ Music
summary: QR login, collections and MP3 import
description: Native QQ Music for X1000: QR login, account collections, song and album artwork, authorized downloads, and tagged MP3 conversion/import. Supports 128/192/320 source presets, cover completion, progress reporting, cancellation and retry. Wi-Fi and clock preparation are integrated. No account data or music is supplied. Feature implementation is complete; the continuous real-account/player playback chain still requires hardware acceptance.
changes: Adds song-list cover thumbnails, missing-cover retrieval, sample-based conversion progress and consistent download/verify/convert/publish stages. Includes native Wi-Fi preparation, a persistent installation ID and explicit session-only clock handling.
